record.body:
## Description

R8: `orchestra handoff` lists each open `composer:idea` that carries an effort under that effort.
R12: The `engage` skill parks an item with `canon create --type composer:idea`.
R13: The `engage` skill promotes an item with `canon supersede --type composer:idea`.
R14: The `engage` skill dismisses an item with `canon supersede --type composer:idea`.
R15: The `engage` skill does not name `score:feedback`.

## Approach

In `orchestra/views.py` change the handoff `backlog` role type to `composer:idea`. Rewrite the backlog and feedback parts of `skills/engage/SKILL.md`: list, park, promote and dismiss use `composer:idea` (payload `effort`, `status`, `source`, optional `phase`); remove every `score:feedback` mention, including the frontmatter description and the Do-not list. Update `tests/test_assess_routing.py`, `tests/test_views.py` and `tests/test_hooks.py` to the new type and text. Update the matching text in `README.md`, `design/canon/schema-modules.md` and `docs/plans/monorepo-plan.md` so they describe the final state. Do not edit `tests/test_idea_view.py`; it is a frozen oracle.

payload.title: Switch handoff view, engage skill and docs to composer:idea
